checks.name: Stereo order
checks.definition: Shots 9 to 15: whenever both sound (a cue of theirs sounding), A pans left of B, at the cloth points (the poser's root + DESIGN.CLOTH.up)
checks.bar: A margin of 0.1 (starting value, about 1.4 dB of channel balance, by ear at Sound 2) in pan; below it "not separated", under 0 an inversion, which fails
checks.summary: 2 shots with both sounding: 0 inverted, 0 not separated; margins over all frames 0.041 to 0.267

checks.name: Perspective at cuts
checks.definition: Every source sounding across every cut: the change in dB and pan under each listener model (camera, characters), keyed on perspective. A 'location' source must not change inside a place. A steady source (SOUND-PLAN 3.6: the lamp's hum and the engine idling at rest from carTimes.stop) follows the hold rule, under 3 dB and 0.25 in pan held as an offset and larger changes applied (no renderer passed: the rendered levels are the hold rule's own, so these verdicts guard the renderer to come (Sound 2) and pass by construction until it is passed). Everything else follows the camera and is reported: a moving continuous source, a one-shot sounding across the cut, and a one-shot source whose gap across the cut is at most 2 times the shorter of its neighbouring gaps (its rhythm carries on; its last cue before the cut heard from both cameras)
checks.bar: A 'location' change inside a place fails; a steady change under the hold threshold (3 (starting value, SOUND-PLAN 3.6) dB, 0.25 (starting value, SOUND-PLAN 3.6) pan) that leaks through, or one over it that is held, fails; jumps of 6 (starting value, SOUND-PLAN 4.3) dB or more listed (a stream's gap at most 2 (starting value, a source's gap across a cut against the shorter of its neighbouring gaps: each stream's measured ratio is in its row) times its rhythm)
checks.summary: 14 cuts, 70 sources across them: 0 failures; steady bg.hum.lamp.bed: 5 changes held (the hold rule's own levels, no renderer yet); 23 following the camera, 9 jumps of 6 dB or more
